description: This file defines the PHP class TemplateIFrame, which extends TemplateURL. It provides methods for rendering HTML input elements, labels, and field definitions specific to an iframe type field in SuiteCRM. The class includes properties for height and type, and methods to generate HTML for editing, labels, detail views, and field definitions.

classes.name: TemplateIFrame
classes.description: A class that extends TemplateURL to handle iframe-specific dynamic field rendering in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns HTML code for editing the iframe field as a text input.

methods.name: get_html_label
methods.description: Returns the label for the iframe field.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Returns the detailed view HTML for the iframe, appending additional content.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array, including height parameter.
